scope: showroom only plus static build integration and new showroom tests/evidence

architecture.dependency: Three.js 0.187.0; local ESM and MIT license; no CDN
architecture.camera: PerspectiveCamera; WebGL2 depth; ACES tone mapping; sRGB output
architecture.materials: MeshPhysicalMaterial transmission, thickness, IOR, clearcoat, attenuation, environment; anisotropic aluminium with directional normal texture
architecture.logo: Original progressorkit-stamp.png inside 3D glass. Available symbol.svg is a different legacy logo, not a vector version of this mark.
architecture.energy: Shaded 3D sphere and one batched XYZ ribbon geometry; 1080 branched filaments at desktop high quality; 360 at lowest desktop quality; 360/240 mobile. Directed deformation toward a raycast project.
architecture.interaction: Original controller receives clicks, retains content/routing/events. HTML provides accessible keyboard controls; canvas raycast handles pointer/touch.
architecture.audio: Only explicit Włącz hum click creates AudioContext. 54 Hz + 108.2/162 harmonics, spatial panner; mute/suspend offscreen/reading/reduced-motion; disposal closes context.

limitations: Glass uses realtime raster transmission and baked studio reflections; not path-traced multi-bounce refraction/caustics. Transparent layers do not refract one another like full ray tracing.
Energy has a shaded sphere surface and spatial branching ribbons, not volumetric raymarching.
DPR is capped at 1 and can fall to 0.65 on desktop; smaller labels lose sharpness.
GPU measurements are latest available asynchronous EXT_disjoint_timer_query_webgl2 results; CPU timing is JS render submission only.
Mobile proof is Chrome touch/viewport emulation on Intel UHD 620, not a physical phone.
No owner aesthetic approval or production deployment is claimed.
proof: 6 PNG, desktop H264 18s, mobile H264 15s; native browser recordings, no generated imagery
